integrity: The proof reconstructs the components directly from the unique order-\(p\) subgroup of each nontrivial cyclic subgroup. The ordinary-domination literature is comparison evidence rather than a proof premise.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite groups of prime-power order.
For \(2\)-groups, the intrinsic condition that every involution is a square is not further classified for all nonabelian groups.
The verification examples are finite corroborations; the arbitrary-group statement rests on the symbolic component proof.
title: Total and paired domination of proper power graphs of finite prime-power groups
